issues: Run timed out (90 min) without delivering setup.sh/env.sh, so the oracle died at `source /work/env.sh`. The transcript shows why. The README model is Dolphin-v2 with 3B parameters (3.75B BF16 per the HF API, 7.5 GB of safetensors), and demo_page.py loads it in float32 on CPU (self.model.float()), about 15 GB of weights before any activations. The first stock run was OOM-killed. The probe then switched to bfloat16, but this CPU (AMD EPYC 7763, no avx512_bf16) ran a 512x2048x11008 bf16 matmul in 28.8 s versus 0.26 s in fp32. The page never finished.

This is directly verifiable from the hub sizes plus demo_page.py: float32 weights alone (~15 GB) leave no room on a 16 GB CPU machine for the vision encoder on a 1700x2200 page. The current README offers no smaller model. Dolphin-1.5 (0.3B) only lives on the v1.5 branch ('Dolphin-1.5 moved to v1.5 branch'). If the owner prefers testing over exclusion, a new exam on branch v1.5 would be the CPU-feasible option.
Harness note: the container's cgroup memory.max was 12884901888 (12 GiB), below the 16 GB the exam prompt promises. That alone guaranteed the float32 OOM here.
